rdfs:label: Distribution
rdfs:comment: A DCAT Distribution — a specific representation of a Dataset (a downloadable file or accessible API).
notes: One Dataset typically has multiple Distributions — CSV, JSON, RDF, API endpoint, archive. Pair with `urn:solid:downloadURL` (direct file URL), `urn:solid:accessURL` (general access page or API), `urn:solid:byteSize`. For IANA media types use `dcat:mediaType` (http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#mediaType) with an IANA IRI; use `urn:solid:format` (dcterms:format) only for non-IANA formats. `urn:solid:mediaType` is the ActivityStreams string property, not `dcat:mediaType`. Linked from a Dataset via `dcat:distribution`.

history.note: Example uses dcat:mediaType with an IANA IRI instead of a bare dcterms:format string; notes clarify mediaType vs format; added accessService/byteSize to seeAlso.
